_doc: Task 10 part B: numbers for the multi-floor hooks (scripts/systems/level_accidents.gd, fire_levels.gd). All optional; defaults live in the scripts.

levels._doc: Stairs and lifts. fall_per_min = chance per game minute standing on a flight of stairs (multiplied by the age / state multipliers); severity = weights of a light / bad / very bad fall; stuck_per_rider_min = chance per rider and minute that a lift stops; rescue_min / repair_min = [min, max] minutes until help arrives / until the lift is repaired.
